_comment: T-306: procedural iron plate armor — SHELL plates keyed by bone, merged per-bone into the wearer's baked mesh (armor_grammar). skeletonId scopes the registered flat generator's rest-pose flatten (boot check / preview); the live render path (syncArmorSlot -> armorGrammarByBone) takes only the bone its render slot covers. Each plate is a thin covering layer over the body-recipe limb, seed-mixed with the boneId so torso/limb plates vary independently. Not class:'character' (plates aren't ground-anchored bodies).
